description: Na₈Gd₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four GdO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 88°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.80 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four GdO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 34°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.88 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.81 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.95 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.40 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four GdO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-91°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.61 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two GdO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GdO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.52 Å. There are two inequivalent Gd sites. In the first Gd site, Gd is bonded to four O atoms to form GdO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one GdO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.21 Å. In the second Gd site, Gd is bonded to four O atoms to form GdO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one GdO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.20 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Gd atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Gd octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 63°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Gd atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Gd atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Gd octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-63°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Gd atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Gd atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Gd octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 9°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Gd atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Gd atom.
